svg.title: Antibes
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study. Approximate geometry, interpretive colours. Hand-traced raised cutout and strings on a white rectangular support. Neutral contour/string guides distinguish construction; they are not extra grey paint. Depth and fine irregularities omitted. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): source review remains unresolved for white; prior provisional screen colors retained, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://www.sfmoma.org/artwork/FC.571/; reviewed 2026-10-27; not a facsimile.
